shared_elements: carved/incised linear motifs on a rock surface
repeated similar signs/forms placed side by side
justification: Both surfaces bear carved linear motifs including a curved element (a semicircular arc bounded by rows of signs in A; rounded spiral-and-limb forms in B) and repetition of similar units along the surface, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A is an abstract rectilinear framework of thin incised lines with bands of script-like signs following the edges, while B shows overlapping curvilinear figurative forms in relief with spirals and a hand-like element, with no border scheme or sign rows at all.
